questions.stemHtml: A 45 year old male presents with 2 year history of progressive weakness and dry mouth. On physical examination, he has bilateral proximal arm and leg weakness along with absent reflexes. On nerve conduction testing sensory responses were normal. Repetitive nerve stimulation at 50 HZ is shown in the figure. Which of the following is false about this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Antibodies are produced against P/Q type calcium channels at motor nerve terminal.

options.label: B
options.text: It is associated with small cell cancer of lung

options.label: C
options.text: Low frequency repetitive nerve stimulation produces a decrementing response
